items.title: Counting Mangoes
parts: One mango, two mangoes, three mangoes in a basket.
Add one more. Now there are four mangoes!
You counted to four. Well done!

items.title: A, B, C Animals
parts: A is for ant, small and strong.
B is for bear, who naps all day long.
C is for cat, who likes to purr. Which letter comes next?
